fixes_ranked_by_revenue.finding: Klarna orders reach GA4 far less often than other orders
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.evidence: 6 of 46 Klarna orders matched (13.0%) against a normal rate of 74.0%
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: buyers finish payment on Klarna's pages and part of them never come back to the Thank you page, where the browser purchase event fires
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.check_after_fix: Klarna capture rate over the next 14 days, against the normal rate

fixes_ranked_by_revenue.finding: Capture fell on 17 to 19 September for every kind of order
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.evidence: 4 of 33 orders matched (12.1%) over the three days, 76.8% on the other days; every device (desktop, mobile) and payment method (klarna, paypal, shopify_payments) with orders those days was hit
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: a change to the site, the custom pixel or an app on 17 September that was undone or fixed on 20 September
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.check_after_fix: the theme, app and GTM version history for 17 and 20 September; daily capture stays near the normal rate

fixes_ranked_by_revenue.evidence: 19 refunded orders, none with a GA4 refund (the refund call returned no rows)
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: nothing sends refund events to GA4
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.check_after_fix: refundAmount on the next refunded orders

fixes_ranked_by_revenue.evidence: 11 orders sent the purchase twice, adding 11 purchases; all on mobile, and the GTM container has 1 GA4 purchase tag
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: the Thank you page reopening or reloading on phones (one sender, so not a second tag)
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.check_after_fix: ids with transactions above 1 over the next 14 days

fixes_ranked_by_revenue.finding: PayPal purchases reaching GA4 with no value
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.evidence: 5 matched orders arrived with purchase revenue 0, all paid with paypal
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: the value the purchase event reads is empty on the PayPal return path
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.check_after_fix: GA4 value against the order's subtotal plus shipping on the next PayPal orders

fixes_ranked_by_revenue.finding: Purchases sent without an order id
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.figure_kind: revenue that can't be matched or deduplicated
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: a second path that fires the purchase event without transaction_id

fixes_ranked_by_revenue.finding: Test orders counted as purchases in GA4
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: test orders placed on the live store fire the same purchase event
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.check_after_fix: use a development store or exclude test traffic before the next test

fixes_ranked_by_revenue.finding: Cancelled orders still counted in GA4
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.evidence: 2 cancelled orders had sent a purchase
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.likely_cause: orders are cancelled after the purchase event fired, and no refund event follows
fixes_ranked_by_revenue.check_after_fix: a refund event sent on cancellation

platform_side.finding: Google Ads counts each purchase twice
platform_side.evidence: 2 counted purchase actions: Google Shopping App Purchase, Purchase (GTM)
platform_side.figure_kind: Google Ads conversion value from the counted purchase action other than the largest (platform value, not store revenue)
platform_side.likely_cause: the Google & YouTube app and the GTM conversion tag both report purchases, and both actions are counted
platform_side.check_after_fix: one counted purchase action; Google leg B back inside the band next month

not_priced: Old Google tag installed as a script tag (https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js, display_scope all, created 2023-03-14): remove it; its Order status part stopped on 26 August 2026, and on the storefront it loads one more copy of the Google tag beside the app and GTM.
order_level_check.note_on_overlap: Findings can overlap (4 Klarna orders fell on 17 to 19 September and are in both of the first two), so the figures are never added; on the 75 orders in either finding, counted once, the revenue unmeasured beyond normal is $2,434.
